988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline

United States
Checked 2026-08-14
Open this listingView details

The 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline provides 24/7, free, and confidential support for people in distress, as well as prevention and crisis resources. It serves anyone facing mental health struggles, emotional distress, or alcohol/drug use concerns.

Special Supplemental Nutrition Program for Women, Infants, and Children

United States
Checked 2026-08-14
Open this listingView details

WIC provides healthy foods, personalized nutrition education, breastfeeding support, and referrals to other services. It serves women who are currently pregnant, recently pregnant, or breastfeeding, and babies and kids under 5.
